// Throwaway writer (never committed on release-4.1): builds one synthetic session
// with every derived-object kind release-4.1 can persist and writes it through the
// REAL save paths — MainWindow::saveLayoutToPath (source-bound and generic) and
// MainWindow::xmlSaveState(kHistory). Output directory: $PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR.

#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <QApplication>
#include <QDir>
#include <QDomDocument>
#include <QFile>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QTemporaryDir>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include "MainWindow.h"
#include "pj_base/builtin/point_cloud.hpp"
#include "pj_base/builtin/point_cloud_codec.hpp"
#include "pj_datastore/object_store.hpp"
#include "pj_datastore/writer.hpp"
#include "pj_plotting/DockWidget.h"
#include "pj_plotting/PlotDocker.h"
#include "pj_plotting/PlotWidget.h"
#include "pj_plotting/TabbedPlotWidget.h"
#include "pj_runtime/AppSession.h"
#include "pj_runtime/CatalogModel.h"
#include "pj_runtime/DataProcessorService.h"
#include "pj_runtime/MarkerService.h"
#include "pj_runtime/MarkerTopics.h"
#include "pj_runtime/SessionManager.h"
#include "pj_scene3d_widgets/Scene3DDockWidget.h"
#include "pj_widgets/VisualizationKind.h"

using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;

namespace PJ {

// Reuses a MainWindow friend name: this file builds into its own executable.
class MainWindowHistoryExemptTestPeer {
 public:
  [[nodiscard]] static AppSession& session(MainWindow& window) {
    return *window.session_;
  }
  static void saveLayout(MainWindow& window, const QString& path, bool include_data_source) {
    window.saveLayoutToPath(path, include_data_source);
  }
  [[nodiscard]] static QDomDocument historySnapshot(const MainWindow& window) {
    return window.xmlSaveState(MainWindow::SnapshotScope::kHistory);
  }
  static void requestFamily(MainWindow& window, DockWidget* dock, VisualizationKind kind) {
    window.onObjectFamilyRequested(dock, kind);
  }
};

}  // namespace PJ

namespace {

using Peer = PJ::MainWindowHistoryExemptTestPeer;

constexpr PJ::Timestamp kSecond = 1'000'000'000LL;
// The saved paths are rewritten to this fake absolute root. The data files must
// exist while saving (a <fileInfo> is written only for a file that does), so the
// session points at real files under a temporary root first.
constexpr const char* kFakeRoot = "/pj-fixtures";

// A Luau transform class whose id must equal the transform's id.
std::string transformScript(const std::string& id, const std::string& expression) {
  return "-- pj-script: luau\nreturn { id=\"" + id + "\", name=\"" + id +
         "\", output=\"same\",\n"
         "  create = function(p) return { calculate = function(t, v) return " +
         expression + " end } end }\n";
}

std::string markerScript(const std::string& series_name) {
  return "local s = series(\"" + series_name +
         "\")\n"
         "if s ~= nil then\n"
         "  for i = 0, s:size() - 1 do createMarker(s:at(i).t) end\n"
         "end\n";
}

PJ::DatasetId addDataset(PJ::AppSession& app, const std::string& source_name) {
  auto domain = app.sessionManager().dataEngine().createTimeDomain(source_name);
  EXPECT_TRUE(domain.has_value());
  auto dataset = app.sessionManager().dataEngine().createDataset(
      PJ::DatasetDescriptor{.source_name = source_name, .time_domain_id = *domain});
  EXPECT_TRUE(dataset.has_value());
  return *dataset;
}

PJ::TopicId addScalarTopic(PJ::AppSession& app, PJ::DatasetId dataset, const std::string& topic, double scale) {
  PJ::DataWriter writer = app.sessionManager().dataEngine().createWriter();
  auto handle = writer.registerScalarSeries(dataset, topic, PJ::NumericType::kFloat64);
  EXPECT_TRUE(handle.has_value());
  for (int index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
    writer.appendScalar(*handle, (index + 1) * kSecond, scale * (index - 2));
  }
  EXPECT_FALSE(app.sessionManager().commitChunks(writer.flushAll()).empty());
  return handle->topic_id;
}

// A float32 xyz cloud of eight points at t = 1 s.
std::vector<uint8_t> smallCloud() {
  std::vector<float> xyz;
  for (int index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
    xyz.insert(
        xyz.end(), {static_cast<float>(index & 1), static_cast<float>((index >> 1) & 1),
                    static_cast<float>((index >> 2) & 1)});
  }
  using DT = PJ::sdk::PointField::Datatype;
  PJ::sdk::PointCloud cloud;
  cloud.frame_id = "map";
  cloud.fields = {{"x", 0, DT::kFloat32, 1}, {"y", 4, DT::kFloat32, 1}, {"z", 8, DT::kFloat32, 1}};
  cloud.point_step = 12;
  cloud.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(xyz.size() / 3);
  cloud.height = 1;
  cloud.row_step = cloud.point_step * cloud.width;
  cloud.data = PJ::Span<const uint8_t>(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(xyz.data()), xyz.size() * sizeof(float));
  cloud.timestamp_ns = kSecond;
  return PJ::serializePointCloud(cloud);
}

// The live catalog key of `topic`'s value column in `dataset`, or empty.
QString keyOf(PJ::AppSession& app, PJ::DatasetId dataset, const QString& topic) {
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();
  for (const PJ::CurveDescriptor& curve : app.catalogModel().curves()) {
    if (curve.dataset_id == dataset && curve.topic_name == topic) {
      return curve.name;
    }
  }
  return {};
}

PJ::TopicId topicIdOf(PJ::AppSession& app, PJ::DatasetId dataset, const QString& topic) {
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();
  for (const PJ::CurveDescriptor& curve : app.catalogModel().curves()) {
    if (curve.dataset_id == dataset && curve.topic_name == topic) {
      return curve.topic_id;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

PJ::PlotWidget* boundPlot(PJ::AppSession& app, PJ::PlotDocker* docker) {
  PJ::DockWidget* dock = docker->plotAt(0);
  if (dock->plotWidget() == nullptr) {
    dock->setPlotWidget(new PJ::PlotWidget(&app.sessionManager(), &app.catalogModel(), dock));
  }
  return dock->plotWidget();
}

QString touch(const QString& path) {
  EXPECT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(QFileInfo(path).absolutePath()));
  QFile file(path);
  EXPECT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly));
  return QFileInfo(path).canonicalFilePath();
}

// `bytes` with every occurrence of the temporary root replaced by kFakeRoot.
QByteArray relocated(QByteArray bytes, const QString& real_root) {
  bytes.replace(real_root.toUtf8(), QByteArray(kFakeRoot));
  EXPECT_FALSE(bytes.contains(real_root.toUtf8()));
  return bytes;
}

QByteArray readFile(const QString& path) {
  QFile file(path);
  EXPECT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly));
  return file.readAll();
}

void writeFile(const QString& path, const QByteArray& bytes) {
  QFile file(path);
  ASSERT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly));
  ASSERT_EQ(file.write(bytes), bytes.size());
}

TEST(Release41FixtureWriter, WritesLayouts) {
  const QString out_dir = qEnvironmentVariable("PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR");
  ASSERT_FALSE(out_dir.isEmpty()) << "set PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR";
  ASSERT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(out_dir));

  QTemporaryDir extensions_dir;
  ASSERT_TRUE(extensions_dir.isValid());
  QTemporaryDir work_dir;
  ASSERT_TRUE(work_dir.isValid());
  const QString path_a = touch(work_dir.filePath(u"pj-fixtures/data/fixture-a.mcap"_s));
  const QString path_b = touch(work_dir.filePath(u"pj-fixtures/data/fixture-b.mcap"_s));
  const QString real_root = QFileInfo(work_dir.filePath(u"pj-fixtures"_s)).canonicalFilePath();
  const QString layout_dir = work_dir.filePath(u"layouts"_s);
  ASSERT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(layout_dir));
  PJ::MainWindow window(extensions_dir.path());
  PJ::AppSession& app = Peer::session(window);
  PJ::SessionManager& session = app.sessionManager();

  // --- datasets: two source-bound files with non-zero alignment offsets ---
  const PJ::DatasetId dataset_a = addDataset(app, "fixture-a.mcap");
  const PJ::DatasetId dataset_b = addDataset(app, "fixture-b.mcap");
  addScalarTopic(app, dataset_a, "/sensor", 1.0);
  const PJ::TopicId imu = addScalarTopic(app, dataset_a, "/imu", 0.5);
  addScalarTopic(app, dataset_b, "/sensor", 2.0);
  addScalarTopic(app, dataset_b, "/odom", 3.0);
  const auto points = session.objectStore().registerTopic(
      PJ::ObjectTopicDescriptor{
          .dataset_id = dataset_a, .topic_name = "/points", .metadata_json = R"({"builtin_object_type":"kPointCloud"})"});
  ASSERT_TRUE(points.has_value());
  ASSERT_TRUE(session.objectStore().pushOwned(*points, kSecond, smallCloud()).has_value());
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();
  session.setDatasetSourcePath(dataset_a, path_a);
  session.setDatasetSourcePath(dataset_b, path_b);
  session.recordLoadedSource(path_a, QString{}, u"MCAP Loader"_s, u"{}"_s, u"mcap-loader"_s);
  session.recordLoadedSource(path_b, QString{}, u"MCAP Loader"_s, u"{}"_s, u"mcap-loader"_s);
  session.setDisplayOffset(dataset_a, PJ::DisplayOffset{PJ::Duration{2'500'000'000LL}});
  session.setDisplayOffset(dataset_b, PJ::DisplayOffset{PJ::Duration{-1'250'000'000LL}});

  // --- transforms: T1 on A, T2 reads T1, T3 history-exempt on B ---
  PJ::DataProcessorService& processors = session.dataProcessorService();
  auto t1 = processors.upsertTransform(
      "fixture-toolbox", "t1", {"/imu"}, {"t1_scaled"}, transformScript("t1", "v * 10.0"), R"({"gain":10})");
  ASSERT_TRUE(t1.has_value()) << t1.error();
  auto t2 = processors.upsertTransform("fixture-toolbox", "t2", {"t1_scaled"}, {"t2_negated"}, transformScript("t2", "-v"), "{}");
  ASSERT_TRUE(t2.has_value()) << t2.error();
  auto t3 = processors.upsertTransform(
      "fixture-assistant", "t3", {"/odom"}, {"t3_exempt"}, transformScript("t3", "-v"), "{}", /*ephemeral=*/false,
      /*input_column_index=*/0, /*history_exempt=*/true);
  ASSERT_TRUE(t3.has_value()) << t3.error();
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();

  // --- filters: one on A's raw series, one on a transform output ---
  auto f1 = processors.applyFilter(imu, dataset_a, "absolute", "imu_abs");
  ASSERT_TRUE(f1.has_value()) << f1.error();
  const PJ::TopicId t1_topic = topicIdOf(app, dataset_a, u"t1_scaled"_s);
  ASSERT_NE(t1_topic, 0U);
  auto f2 = processors.applyFilter(t1_topic, dataset_a, "absolute", "t1_abs");
  ASSERT_TRUE(f2.has_value()) << f2.error();
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();

  // --- marker generators ---
  PJ::MarkerService& markers = session.markerService();
  PJ::MarkerService::GeneratorRecipe on_a;
  on_a.id = "fixture-toolbox/rule/a-sensor";
  on_a.dataset_id = dataset_a;
  on_a.inputs = {"/sensor/value"};
  on_a.outputs = {"a_sensor_markers"};
  on_a.script = markerScript("/sensor/value");
  on_a.params_json = R"({"threshold":1.5})";
  ASSERT_TRUE(markers.upsertGenerator(on_a).has_value());

  PJ::MarkerService::GeneratorRecipe all_datasets;
  all_datasets.id = "fixture-toolbox/rule/all";
  all_datasets.all_datasets = true;
  all_datasets.inputs = {"/sensor/value"};
  all_datasets.outputs = {std::string(PJ::kAllDatasetsMarkerTopic)};
  all_datasets.script = markerScript("/sensor/value");
  ASSERT_TRUE(markers.upsertGenerator(all_datasets).has_value());

  PJ::MarkerService::GeneratorRecipe on_t1;
  on_t1.id = "fixture-toolbox/rule/t1";
  on_t1.dataset_id = dataset_a;
  on_t1.inputs = {"t1_scaled/value"};
  on_t1.outputs = {"t1_markers"};
  on_t1.script = markerScript("t1_scaled/value");
  ASSERT_TRUE(markers.upsertGenerator(on_t1).has_value());

  PJ::MarkerService::GeneratorRecipe declared;
  declared.id = "fixture-toolbox/rule/declared";
  declared.dataset_id = dataset_a;
  declared.inputs = {"/sensor/value"};
  declared.declared_inputs = {"fixture-a.mcap:/sensor/value"};
  declared.outputs = {"declared_markers"};
  declared.script = markerScript("fixture-a.mcap:/sensor/value");
  ASSERT_TRUE(markers.upsertGenerator(declared).has_value());

  PJ::MarkerService::GeneratorRecipe exempt;
  exempt.id = "fixture-assistant/rule/odom";
  exempt.dataset_id = dataset_b;
  exempt.inputs = {"/odom/value"};
  exempt.outputs = {"odom_markers"};
  exempt.script = markerScript("/odom/value");
  exempt.history_exempt = true;
  ASSERT_TRUE(markers.upsertGenerator(exempt).has_value());
  session.notifyMarkersChanged();
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();

  // --- plots: curves on filter/transform outputs; one hidden marker scope ---
  auto* tabs = window.findChild<PJ::TabbedPlotWidget*>(u"tabbedPlotWidget"_s);
  ASSERT_NE(tabs, nullptr);
  PJ::PlotWidget* first = boundPlot(app, tabs->currentTab());
  for (const QString& topic : {u"imu_abs"_s, u"t1_scaled"_s, u"t2_negated"_s, u"/sensor"_s}) {
    const QString key = keyOf(app, dataset_a, topic);
    ASSERT_FALSE(key.isEmpty()) << topic.toStdString();
    ASSERT_NE(first->addCurve(key), nullptr) << topic.toStdString();
  }
  PJ::PlotDocker* second_tab = tabs->addTab(u"fixture-derived"_s);
  ASSERT_NE(second_tab, nullptr);
  PJ::PlotWidget* second = boundPlot(app, second_tab);
  ASSERT_NE(second->addCurve(keyOf(app, dataset_a, u"t1_abs"_s)), nullptr);
  ASSERT_NE(second->addCurve(keyOf(app, dataset_b, u"t3_exempt"_s)), nullptr);
  ASSERT_NE(second->addCurve(keyOf(app, dataset_b, u"/sensor"_s)), nullptr);
  QCoreApplication::processEvents();
  second->setDatasetMarkerScopeVisible(dataset_b, PJ::MarkerScope::kAllDatasets, false);

  // --- one single-dataset 3D scene dock ---
  PJ::PlotDocker* scene_tab = tabs->addTab(u"fixture-scene"_s);
  ASSERT_NE(scene_tab, nullptr);
  Peer::requestFamily(window, scene_tab->plotAt(0), PJ::VisualizationKind::kScene3D);
  auto* scene = qobject_cast<PJ::Scene3DDockWidget*>(scene_tab->plotAt(0)->objectWidget()->widget());
  ASSERT_NE(scene, nullptr);
  ASSERT_TRUE(scene->addTopic(*points, PJ::sdk::BuiltinObjectType::kPointCloud, u"points"_s));
  QCoreApplication::processEvents();

  for (const auto& [name, source_bound] : {std::pair{u"source_bound.pj4.xml"_s, true}, {u"generic.pj4.xml"_s, false}}) {
    const QString saved = QDir(layout_dir).filePath(name);
    Peer::saveLayout(window, saved, source_bound);
    writeFile(QDir(out_dir).filePath(name), relocated(readFile(saved), real_root));
  }
  writeFile(
      QDir(out_dir).filePath(u"history_snapshot.xml"_s),
      relocated(Peer::historySnapshot(window).toByteArray(2), real_root));
  // The writer session's ids, for the README (history snapshots carry raw ids only).
  writeFile(
      QDir(out_dir).filePath(u"writer_dataset_ids.txt"_s),
      u"fixture-a.mcap=%1\nfixture-b.mcap=%2\n"_s.arg(dataset_a).arg(dataset_b).toUtf8());
}

}  // namespace
